title: Persist swarm ownership epochs and fence side effects before execution
goal: P1: LeaseTable and next_fence live only in memory; PersistedMission omits ownership epochs and leases; live DAG checks completion fences after executing shell commands. Persist monotonic mission/coordinator epochs, leases, renewal and recovery state atomically. Reject stale, expired and wrong-owner authority at each mutating tool/write boundary before any side effect, not only when accepting output. Prevent old worker processes from writing after takeover; reconcile or stop them before redispatch. Add nonzero hermetic production-entry integration tests named swarm_gap_durable_fencing_* for coordinator kill/restart, worker takeover, delayed old writes, expired leases and duplicate completion; assert old workers produce no side effects and restart cannot reuse an earlier authority token. Preserve existing tests and acceptance records; add regression tests that fail before the repair and execute at least one test. Do not close this task merely because a helper exists or a test filter runs zero tests.
